subject: Problems fitting an anova like model (from Kruschke's Doing Bayesian Data Analysis)

messages.author: 497eb9c410b69640
messages.subject: Problems fitting an anova like model (from Kruschke's Doing Bayesian Data Analysis)
parts:
I'm trying to replicate the robust anova model, with heterogenous variances, from Kurschke's book  (p. 603), the code I'm using can be found here:
https://github.com/jonsjoberg/ANOVA_like/blob/master/robust_anova.ipynb

Depending on priors (i've tried a few) I get different errors/warnings, but they are all centered around that some parameters are either 'nan' or 'Inf', and then the chains takes forever to complete. 

I really have two questions, can anyone help me with what I'm doing wrong? And in general how would you improve a model like this?

Thanks in advance!
